# The big data grids open under a headline; Settings stops covering columns

## Context

The operator, 19 Nov, on `examples/grid/bigData` and `examples/grid/treeBigData`: both "previously had a gap on top of the grid", with the menu button above where the grid began; "now it is literally floating over the grid content. gray floating button over gray background." Then: "if you want the top gap for the grids, there should be a title … or the high contrast floating button. both strategies can work." And on the big data grid's nested component: "looks really ugly, especially inside the dark theme. maybe make it a badge / chip / pill?"

## The Problem

Measured at `dev` `19058bf0ab`, 1024×768, dark theme, both examples:

- The grid starts at y = 0. The 35 px menu button (`#3c3f41`) sits on the header row (`#323232`), 1.21 : 1 against it, and covers the last visible header label (bigData: "May 2022" reads "May 2"; treeBigData: "Utilization") and the first rows' cells.
- With Settings open, the grid stays 1024 px wide under the 235 px panel, so its right columns sit under the panel.
- Cause: `#9634` (`05b823c814`, 2 Apr) removed the grid's `.neo-grid-wrapper` node. Both examples still style it (`resources/css/src/examples/grid/bigData/MainContainer.css:2`, `treeBigData/MainContainer.css:2`): the pages hold 0 such nodes, the grid's margin computes to `0px`, and the `neo-extend-margin-right` class the button adds lands on `.neo-grid-container`, which no rule reads.
- Before `#9634` the band above the grid was a margin with nothing in it.
- bigData's nested component (`NestedCell.mjs`) has no style of its own: its label sits in the theme's container box (`#2b2b2b`), 19 px tall and flush to its text.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/grid/bigData/MainContainer.mjs`: a Viewport, `hbox`, holding the grid and `ControlsContainer`. The controls are absolute (`right: -235px`, sliding to `0`); the button sits 53 px left of the panel. `treeBigData` mirrors it.
- `ControlsContainer.mjs:267` (bigData), `:339` (treeBigData) toggle `neo-expanded` on the panel and, 250 ms later, `neo-extend-margin-right` on the grid.
- The engine's `.neo-grid-container` rule sets `height: 100%; width: 100%` since `#9634`.
- The renewed Grid & Table examples open on a headline, one line on what to try, and their controls (`examples/grid/nestedRecordFields/Viewport.mjs:21`).
- `NestedCell` writes its label's vdom without an update of its own, so a scroll recycle repaints the cell atomically; `ComponentCellScrollSync.spec.mjs` reads `.bigdata-nested-cell-label`. Theme CSS loads per class, so the engine `Chip`'s `--chip-*` tokens are absent from a page that uses no `Chip`.

Design authority: `#21175`, "its own viewport, a headline, one line that says what to try, a theme button"; `#21163`, "a line in a header is acceptable".

## The Fix

The headline, not the colour. A stronger button colour makes a control that covers data easier to see, not less in the way (prototyped at `#5d83a7`, 3.22 : 1: "May 2022" stays covered), and the band without a title is what the operator turned down.

1. Both examples: a header above the grid, with a headline and one line on what to try; the menu button sits at its right end and covers no grid content.
2. The open panel takes its room: the class that makes room is read by a rule that matches an element on the page.
3. The nested label is a pill tinted with the grid's accent, its colours in the example's dark and light theme files; the cell keeps its structure.
4. Covers `devmode/grid-big-data-14.jpg` and `devmode/grid-tree-big-data-14.jpg` re-shot with `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs`, recipes adjusted if the frame needs it, on `neomjs/pages` `main` before this merges.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both examples at 1440×900 and 1024×768, dark and light: a headline and one line above the grid; no grid cell or header label under the menu button.
- [ ] Settings open: the grid's right edge stays left of the panel in both examples.
- [ ] The page `<title>` does not change (`#21163`: "The title is a search asset").
- [ ] The two covers are re-shot and on Pages `main`.
- [ ] The specs that load `examples/grid/bigData/` or `examples/grid/treeBigData/` pass.
- [ ] The nested component reads as a chip in the dark and the light theme, its text at 4.5 : 1 or more.

## Out of Scope

The grid engine; what the Settings panel holds; the footer `#21163` added; the nested label's text.

## Avoided Traps

- **An accent colour on a button that covers data.** It hides the same cells, louder.
- **The empty band back.** The operator's condition for a gap is a title.
- **The engine `Chip` in every cell.** A focusable, closable component per recycled cell, and the cell's atomic label write would reach into its internals.
